issues.description: Default base image 'python:3.12' is duplicated across Python and TypeScript with no single source of truth.
issues.detail: DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE lives in pipeline.py, the Commands.ts catch-branch fallback, and as an exported constant in CellMetadataEditor.tsx (plus the Jinja template fallback chain). The RPC was added to centralize this value, yet four copies remain and will silently drift on the next version bump. Trust the RPC as the single source and remove the literal copies.

issues.description: Silent behavior change in _set_base_image: empty-string fallback now pins python:3.12 instead of deferring to KFP's default.
issues.detail: Previously self.base_image = '' meant 'let KFP choose'; now it forces 'python:3.12' whenever pod introspection fails. This conflates 'unspecified' with a concrete tag, changes runtime image selection for failing-pod paths, and contradicts the adjacent 'Use kfp default image' comment. Split this semantic change from the UI work or document and migrate callers explicitly.

issues.description: Effective-base-image precedence chain is reimplemented in 3+ sites (Jinja template, InlineMetadata, dialog placeholder) instead of one resolver.
issues.detail: The rule 'step.base_image or pipeline.base_image or default' appears in Python templates and TS render sites with subtly different orderings and fallback terms. When precedence changes, all sites must move in lockstep. Factor into one named resolver (e.g. resolveBaseImage) with a stated contract, or resolve once at the server boundary and ship a single string down.

issues.description: Replacing the inline Input with a Button-plus-Dialog is a UX regression and adds framework for one string field.
issues.detail: The previous panel exposed the current base image directly as an editable Input; the new UI hides it behind a 5%-wide button labeled 'IMAGE' that opens a modal with one field. This adds state, components, and a click cost while hiding observable state. A placeholder or helper text on the original Input would have surfaced the default without the modal.

issues.description: createBaseImageText now always renders, changing its prior 'empty-when-unset' invariant without auditing callers.
issues.detail: The function previously returned '' when no baseImage was set; it now unconditionally renders a paragraph with the resolved default plus '(default)'. Callers that gated layout on the empty sentinel, or non-step cell types (imports/functions/skip), may now display meaningless base-image lines. Verify caller gating or restore the conditional render.

issues.description: Button style width: '5%' with label 'IMAGE' is an unmeasured magic constant that will not render predictably.
issues.detail: A 5% width on a button containing the word 'IMAGE' depends on parent flex context the component cannot see and will clip or wrap on common viewport widths. Either size by content (auto), let MUI size it, or own the layout contract at the row level with a stated rationale.

synthesis.summary: The panel reaches strong consensus that this PR ships a reasonable feature (surface the default base image) but executes it without single-source-of-truth discipline. The string 'python:3.12' now lives in at least three places — pipeline.py, a TS constant, and a Commands.ts catch-branch fallback — defeating the purpose of the new RPC and guaranteeing drift on the next version bump. Worse, the pipeline.py change silently rewrites _set_base_image's empty-string semantics (previously 'defer to KFP') into a hardcoded python:3.12, a runtime behavior change piggybacked on a UI patch. The Input-to-Dialog UI swap is a regression that hides observable state for one string field, the effective-image precedence chain is reimplemented across multiple sites, and the 5%-width IMAGE button is an unmeasured layout smell. Recommend: consolidate the default to one source, split the pipeline.py semantic change into its own discussion, and simplify the UI back toward the original inline Input.
